notes.title: The Moment of Decision: On the Peak of Mars!
notes.notes:
🌱 Farming - A Living World
Mars is cold, barren, and hostile to life. But you see more. You believe in a future where people walk freely without spacesuits, where food grows in soil once thought dead, and where flowers bloom on stone that never knew life. With vision, grit, and cutting-edge bioengineering, you will transform Mars into humanity’s second Earth, a place where hope takes root and spreads.

⛏️ Mining – Build the Empire Beneath the Dust
Above ground? Who cares. Mars glows red because it bleeds rare minerals—the kind Earth ran out of long ago. Richer than gold mines. Deeper than oil wells. Mine like a mad genius, carving out vast networks below the surface and building a hidden empire powered by wealth beyond Earth’s dreams. This is more than survival, this is domination through industry.

🔥 Military – Rule the Planet Through Fire and Steel
The bugs once ruled Mars. Ruthless. Endless. Supreme. Now you rule them with missiles, mechs, and nuclear fire. To survive, you had to become stronger, faster, more terrifying than the creatures that once made this planet a graveyard. Yes, radiation comes with a cost. But now, the most feared force on Mars… isn’t the bugs. It’s you. When you launch a bug raid, it's a full-scale pest control by nuclear annihilation on the entire Red Planet. 

Each path comes with unique mechanics, tech trees, and high-stakes choices. You can master one or mix them to forge your own legend. The odds are against you, and Mars doesn’t give second chances.
Terraform and Conquer.  What legacy will you leave on the Red Planet?

MARS: The Last Exodus Team

notes.title: 🚀 We're Teaming up with NAGA!
notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to announce that we’re officially partnering with NAGA. They are very professional, passionate, eager, and engaged.[/p][p]With NAGA's amazing marketing experience, we'll be sharing more frequent updates, gameplay reveals, and behind-the-scenes looks into the development of MARS: The Last Exodus.[/p][p]This collaboration marks a new chapter in our journey, where we hope to better connect with all of you, listen to your feedback, grow this cherished community, and bring Mars to life. [/p][p]Stay tuned for upcoming posts featuring detailed breakdowns of the three core factions, Military, Mining, and Farming, and how your choices will shape the future of Mars.  [/p][p]Our partnership with NAGA covers global publishing efforts, while our strategy for the Chinese market remains under development and open to local collaboration.  [/p][p]MARS: The Last Exodus Team [/p]
